result.title: ZeroGraph: Compositional Blockwise Training via Materialized Boundary Supervision
result.comment: 15 pages, 5 figures. Code available at https://github.com/oramada/ZeroGraph
result.summary: Blockwise learning can remove online gradient dependencies across depth, but independently optimized blocks need not compose into a useful model. We present ZeroGraph, a systems transformation for pretrained-model conversion and distillation that materializes a frozen teacher's coherent boundary trajectory as a versioned dataset. Each partition then trains with disjoint parameters, optimizer state, random state, and checkpoints, replacing live cross-depth dependencies with persistent supervision. Experiments separate learning quality from systems behavior. On GPT-2 Large, an unanchored objective reduces denoising error by 99.44%, yet assembled held-out cross-entropy worsens from 3.63 to 10.48 and context use becomes negative. A six-arm TinyLlama study identifies clean teacher-boundary regression as the successful interface; the tested noisy objective fails with cached or online targets. The clean recipe passes quality and context-use gates across three Qwen2.5-1.5B seeds and on a 3.086B Qwen2.5 model. In an objective-matched comparison, cached and online targets are bitwise identical. Cached jobs are faster after materialization, but a 618.31 s cache-build cost prevents wall-time break-even through 16 measured reuses. Boundary-shift tests show tolerance to intermediate representation mismatch, and an interrupted block resumes to a bitwise-identical final state without rerunning unaffected blocks. In the tested pretrained-model conversion and distillation setting, cross-depth semantic dependence can move from online optimization into persistent data.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 ZeroGraph，把冻结教师的连贯边界轨迹物化为版本化数据集，使各分块以互不共享的参数、优化器与随机状态独立训练，用持久监督替代跨深度的在线梯度依赖，并区分学习质量与系统行为；实验显示无锚定目标虽降低去噪误差，但组装后困惑度反而恶化，干净的教师边界回归才是成功接口。
AI.relevance_reason: 其分块边界监督、缓存目标与在线目标的逐位一致、以及对中间表示失配的容忍度，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 轨迹的分段监督、贡献分配与状态缓存复用是否会破坏组装后推理的一致性；该方法属纯文本训练系统层面，迁移需自行验证。
